resources.string: Use your phone as your Mac\'s remote
Install the free MightyMouse app on your Mac
Open it. Your Mac shows a QR code.
That code isn\'t from MightyMouse. Scan the one MightyMouse shows on your Mac.
Can\'t reach your Mac. Check it is awake and on the same Wi-Fi, then try again.
Point your camera at the code on your Mac
